rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from providers approved by APA, ASWB, CAMFT, CPA, NASP, NASW or NBCC; Board-recognized providers (AAMFT, AAMFT-CA, CALPCC, CAMFT, NASW-CA, CSCSW, CASP, CPA, CCA, ACA); qualifying postsecondary institutions (1 semester unit = 15 h, 1 quarter unit = 10 h); teaching for accepted providers (max 18 h per period)
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 36 hours during the first renewal period plus a 7-hour HIV/AIDS course (and the one-time suicide and telehealth courses if not submitted with the licensure application).
rules.audit_note: Certify completion under penalty of perjury at renewal; do not submit certificates unless audited. Keep records at least 2 years from the renewal date.

topics.who: All licensees, one time: due at the first renewal or reactivation after Jan 1, 2021, unless proof was already submitted with the licensure application
All licensees, one time: due at the first renewal or reactivation after Jul 1, 2023, unless proof was already submitted with the licensure application; must include telehealth law and ethics
Supervisors of associates and MFT trainees (continuing professional development)

rules.notes: The license expires on the date printed on it: the Board sets the expiration date of the original license, no more than 24 months after issue (Bus. & Prof. Code §4984(a)), and it then renews every two years. Renewal period runs from the day after issue/prior expiration to the license expiration date. One-time courses taken before the renewal period count for the one-time requirement but not toward the 36 hours. Associates: 3 hours California law and ethics per yearly renewal.
